heading.title: Suits by or against the government or public officers in their official capacity

article.title: Government to be joined as a party in a suit against a public officer.
article.content: Where a suit is instituted against a public officer for damages or other relief in respect of any act alleged to have been done by him in his official capacity, the Government shall be joined as a party to the suit.
article.html:
5AGovernment to be joined as a party in a suit against a public officer.

Order 27, Rule 5A

Where a suit is instituted against a public officer for damages or other relief in respect of any act alleged to have been done by him in his official capacity, the Government shall be joined as a party to the suit.

10 Ins. by Act 104 of 1976, s. 76 (w.e.f. 1-2-1977).
